title: PLEASE DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY
text: PLEASE DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY. What pieces of trash, literally! These are just flat pieces of cardboard with a cheap picture on it. Save yourself money and print out a picture of books and tape it on the ones in your library, and save a ton of money.

product_metadata.title: Bits and Pieces - Heavy-Duty File Organizer and Magazine Holder – Set of 3 – Decorative Classic Books Themed Magazine Rack - 3" x 11" x 12
features: Magazine/File Holder: You can now easily store or hide your papers, magazines, and files with Bits and Pieces’ stylish File Organizer and Magazine Holder. It is sturdy, light-weight and has immense space to fit all your documents.

Office Accessories: Desk accessories need not be boring! Our heavy-duty file organizer is a superb desk accessory that will automatically grab your visitor’s attention. You can display our magazine holder on tables or shelves and in the home or office.

Easy To Use: This Decorative Classic Books Themed foldable set of magazine file holders is shipped flat and can be easily expanded. There is no complicated assembly required. You simply unfold them and then let the organizing commence.

Heavy-Duty File Organizer: Our magazine storage box has been crafted from thick and heavy-duty cardboard that prevents the items stored inside from getting damaged. It is strong and spacious and can easily accommodate your widest magazines.
Size Details: This set of 3 heavy-duty file organizers measures 3"" x 11"" x 12"" and is the perfect solution to keep all your documents in one place.
